verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of controlling payout or settlement timing, and nothing on a per-payout breakdown of the charges, fees and refunds that make up each payout. The nearby items do not fit this story: subscription billing frequency governs when customers are charged, manual or automatic processing concerns transaction capture, and the CLI's generic mention of 'reports' does not describe payout reconciliation. None of these is the payouts capability itself.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can control the payout schedule and see exactly which charges, fees, and refunds make up each payout
